subject: sounds
title: sh, ch and th
about: Hear a word and pick which two-letter team makes its first or last sound: sh, ch or th. These consonant digraphs are NC RF.1.4.a and are taught in CKLA Unit 1 lessons 17 and 18.
tip: Remind him that two letters can hold hands and make one new sound.

cards.q: Which letters make the first sound in ship?
cards.note: ship starts with the sh sound. Two letters, one sound.

cards.note: shop starts with the sh sound. Two letters, one sound.
